column1: # params: extra query parameters (lang=en&typos=true, focus=lon,lat), or - for none.
# expect: what the right result looks like, as `;`-separated conditions:
#   name=A|B     its name is one of these (case-insensitive)
#   near=lat,lon,km   its center is within km of the point
#   tag=k=v      it has OSM tag k=v (v matched as a `;` list element)
#   kind=admin   it's of this kind (v1 responses only; ignored for legacy ones)
#   in=A         one of its admins is named A (v1 responses only)
# Larger places elsewhere should win over smaller namesakes.
# The best known of many namesakes.
# POIs, including ones whose names contain admin names.
# Where the place is should count for more than the category's name.
# But not over a name that matches.
# Names the category model reads as categories (Spokane as a station).
# Bounding boxes. The second box holds the north-east of the campus but not
# its center, so only a result with its real shape matches.
# Focus: the nearest of a chain, for search-as-you-type from a map viewport.
# Focus picks the nearby one of same-named places.
# But a strong match far away beats a weak one nearby.
# Focus at the scale of regions: of two places with one name, the one in your
# part of the world, unless the other is far better known.
# Autocomplete as the app sends it (prefix and typos): the word being typed
# completes to well-known places rather than matching obscure ones exactly.
